v1.0.12: verified WireGuard peer monitoring and honest Android VPN safety fixes.
- When VPN settings is visible, refresh real peer handshake every 15 seconds; stop polling when hidden.
- Reject stale, future, or absent peer responses. JUnit boundary suite required by CI and signed release.
- Native GoBackend rx/tx counters and handshake age shown without server key, address or browser history.
- Async operation epoch prevents late "connected" display after disconnect/delete; reject duplicate file imports.
- AES-GCM error-path buffer wiping and deletion of profile's Android Keystore encryption key.
- Android Always-on VPN opt-out because system startup restore and OS lockdown are NOT implemented.
- No user server, no system kill-switch, no guaranteed background reconnect. No claim of live server / DNS/IPv6/WebRTC leak tests.
Verified source/build/JUnit CI: https://github.com/mmustafatasoy/EymenBrowser/actions/runs/42209002553
Android 15/16 emulator UI audit: https://github.com/mmustafatasoy/EymenBrowser/actions/runs/42208848440
See docs/ANDROID_VPN_V112.md for limits.
Release must match pinned production cert, pass previous v1.0.11 APK upgrade, signed 3-ABI and SHA256 check.
